ETE 503.name: English Curriculum Review
ETE 503.description: The course provides students with knowledge and experience to assist them to become effective English teachers. The major areas of the English curriculum taught in schools, especially in high schools, will be reviewed in detail and related to the demands made on high school teachers and students. The topics covered include curriculum objectives, content and implementation, assessment, the school-based language curriculum, textbooks used in schools, the IGCSE curriculum, and IB language curricula.

ETE 504.name: Literature for Young Learners
ETE 504.description: The course focuses on literary works that address young learners, using a wide variety of literary genres. Fictional texts written for young people will be studied, ranging from tales and short stories to young adult novels, with an emphasis on twentieth century fiction. Participants will learn how to use the texts in the school classroom, and how to relate them to the interests of school students, as well as how to analyze texts and teach literary concepts and devices.
